title: I made my first game using AI and I want to know what you guys think of it.
author: Silexriv
selftext:
Hi guys so I made my first game ever and I want to share with you what I did and want to know what you think of it.   
  
I am a QA tester myself so I know a bit about the structure to make a game. At first this game was made with features added as I was testing it. The game is almost entirely made with AI.  
I got the help of my brother to setup everything to make it easier to build and integrate new features as I was making it. (using Jira to make task for the AI)

I did a lot of experimenting and it got to what it is now. I'm pretty much done with it so try it and tell me what you guys think.  
Also for a better experience I highly recommend doing the Challenge Mode. It is harder but also got more feature in it.

Also my goal is to make a website where all the game I make will be playable like those old website with all the flash games. That is what I am building right now and this is where the game is playable.

Here is the link: [https://onesitting.studio/](https://onesitting.studio/)

comments.author: test_test_1_2
comments.body:
I find the font a little hard to read from my mobile. It's a cool font, but hard to read. 

When I swing the sword, the player always turns forward and swings. It does not swing in the direction that you're facing.

I'll try playing it again from my PC. Looks really nice, great job with it. I also love the idea of having an ending without having to give up RL.
